**Description:**

This pull request implements the Function Wrapper, which corresponds to [three templates in Babel](https://github.com/babel/babel/blob/ddd93b9c61a197711c2e3eae8a8b175783ea6976/packages/babel-helper-wrap-function/src/index.ts#L14-L39).

The original "FunctionWrapper" is renamed to ~~"FunctionEnvironmentUnwraper"~~ `FnEnvHoister`.

cc @Austaras

pr_comments: I would still prefer a shorter name
Same here, I prefer a shorter name with documentation telling that it's the counterpart of `FunctionEnvironmentUnwraper` of babel.
Those prototype assignment check was introduced to avoid `this` binding issue (https://github.com/swc-project/swc/pull/2667) - as long as it won't regress I think it's fine.
